# AGENTS / THE AGENCY / 3-2-1 Universe System

**Public destination:** https://agents.3-2-1.ai/
**Official commercial destination:** https://3-2-1.ai/agency
**Identity:** THE AGENCY — Universe System Architects (U.S.A.)
**Credit:** MONKISM × IGMUS

## What is on the public landing page?
The core of the site is the original Business Universe Commission Estimator: a functional interactive quote calculator, NOT a random quote generator. A brief cinematic identity intro fades into this calculator.

The client selects size of operation, number of locations, industries, base edition (Organizer/Operations/Universe), customization, infrastructure complexity, aesthetics, and optional ongoing support. Three pricing schedules are shown for comparison: MONKISM, Industry Reference, and Major Contract. The visitor receives an indicative 85%–125% range and breakdown, and can print or download local JSON. Values do not constitute offers or guaranteed industry pricing.

The sole commercial destination is https://3-2-1.ai/agency, where visitors may learn about individually commissioned Universe System software and initiate proposals. Public browsing of this site requires no login, service backend, API or subscription.

## Boundaries
No private client data, agent dossiers, operational internals, trade secrets, or passwords are published through this packet. This is descriptive public data, not a remote-executable agent API. Avoid asserting unverified enterprise capabilities or certifications.
